## Data integrity (non-negotiable)

This demo uses the shared spectra contract:

- Contract: `docs/contracts/spectra-data-contract.md`
- Seed atomic lines: `demos/_assets/spectra/atomic-lines.v1.json`

Rule: if a feature is not sourced, it must be marked `verified: false` and displayed with a visible “VERIFY” badge.

## Instrument model (teaching simplification)

- The demo can broaden lines to mimic finite instrument resolution.
- Line “strengths” are illustrative and are not treated as physical transition probabilities in v1.

## Kirchhoff mode mapping

- Hot dense source → continuous spectrum
- Hot thin gas → emission spectrum
- Cool gas in front of hot source → absorption spectrum on a continuum
